title: brawlz 98
text: a new 2d pixel platform fighter. 12 original fighters inspired by the site's cursed emoji, three desktop arenas, double jumps, directional attacks and recovery specials. share a room code for online 1v1 or 2v2; bots take the empty seats. keyboard, touch and gamepad.

title: waveshaper 98
text: four buttons, one wave. square up, square down, triangle up, triangle down. hit each bend exactly at the target. correct hits speed up the wave; mistakes cost a life and cut current speed by 40%. keyboard, touch and gamepad, inside the desktop. also on the setlist: baka mitai, with its own late-night karaoke bar.

title: trailz 98: light cycles
text: new game. you ride a light cycle on a neon grid, turn at right angles and leave a wall behind you. touch any wall, yours too, and you are out. ride close beside one and you go faster. up to eight online, bots in the empty seats, three cameras, works on a phone.

title: sir, we have a troll problem, again
text: the tower defense is new: the desktop defends itself with pointer posts, floppy launchers, fax machines, a ban hammer and six more, put down anywhere off the road. two upgrade paths each, one goes all the way. and up to four of you on one road, each with your own money and towers. old upgrades are refunded.

title: age of troll: the trolls move
text: every troll in age of troll walks, swings and dies its own way now, and the five that shoot throw their own thing: a hi! bubble, a laser, a frying pan, a ?! and a little trollface. 53 animations in all.

title: open lobbies
text: no friends online? same. the multiplayer lobby now lists open games from strangers: wizardz, dungeonz, age of troll. click join, or hit quick match and it finds you one, or opens yours and waits there.

title: the trophy room
text: every achievement, every record and how long you have spent in each game, on one wall. locked ones come with a hint. and the site installs now: start menu, install mrhakan 98, and it opens in its own window, offline too.

title: age of troll: replays
text: every match ends with a link now. send it to somebody and they watch the whole thing from the start: pause it, run it at 8x, drag to the good bit, look from either side. no server, the match is in the link.

title: dungeonz 98
text: a co-op raid on the wizardz engine. up to four of you, bots in the empty seats, three dungeons from easy to blue screen. kill minions, level up, spend cards at the shrines, close the boss.

title: wizardz 98: 4 v 4
text: 2 v 2, 3 v 3 and 4 v 4, with bots in whatever seats you have no friends for. and three new maps that are actually different. also loadout ids: type somebody's in and you have their eight, or take one of ten ready made.

title: wizardz 98, in 3d
text: it is a third person shooter now, and it looks like 1996. draw a sigil to load your staff, then go and hit somebody. fifty new symbols, on a phone too.

title: age of troll
text: a long lane war with the site's trolls. five ages, two walls, and a bot or a bradar online to throw them at.

title: flood tiles 98
text: flood the whole board from one corner, one colour at a time. a new board every day and 25 moves to do it in.

title: aspect frame 98
text: try an image in every aspect ratio and fit, then copy the css. it all stays in your browser.

title: color echo 98
text: simon, with a seeded sequence every day. remember the colours or do not.

title: pattern loom 98
text: a seamless svg pattern maker. five motifs, a randomise button, and an export that is yours.
